thread:
ops-bot: [ALERT] capacity_saturation_high triggered in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-15T03:14:27Z. tokens/sec above expected and throttle_count rising.

sam jasper: seeing spike in tokens/sec from frontend pool, token-throttle metric up ~12x. customers hitting streaming timeouts :grimacing:

alex chen: on it, grabbing dashboards. are we seeing CPU or queue buildup?

maria rodriguez: queue_depth per-worker mostly flat but queue_depth_p95/p99 are spiking. looks like hot shards. throttles line up with model fallback logs.

sam jasper: paging @oncall-rotation-bot — P1.

oncall-rotation-bot: Pager routed to sam jasper and alex chen. Incident priority: P1.

alex chen: enabling burst_capacity pool for eu-west-1 now (manual override). running:
```
redwoodctl capacity override set --pool eu-west-1 --mode burst --until +15m
```

sam jasper: good. also increasing dedicated autoscale max_replicas by +20% for eu-west pools.

maria rodriguez: patching autoscale policy to relax aggressive downscale window so we don't oscillate; will canary to one shard.

alex chen: quick map: throttle_count by model shows majority on model-r8-large — probably KV cache contention / kernel regression. routing small percentage of traffic to model-r8-medium as fallback.

sam jasper: prefer infra-level routing vs customer-facing model rollback.

maria rodriguez: pushed a routing tweak to route non-interactive classification to medium model.

leo: adding a short-lived composite alert to avoid noisy queue_depth-only pages:
```
ALERT CapacityHotPath
IF (increase(queue_depth_p95[2m]) > 50) and (increase(throttle_count[2m]) > 5)
FOR 1m
LABELS {severity=\"page\"}
```

sam jasper: add a 60s dedupe and silence the existing queue_depth_eu-west alert while we validate.

ops-bot: silenced: /alerts/queue_depth_eu-west-1 for 30m by sam jasper

alex chen: mitigating: tail of worker logs shows repeated kernel mem pressure on inference-worker-12. isolating that node now.

maria rodriguez: isolating + drain in progress. should free KV memory and reduce throttles.

sam jasper: customer impact: ~18 requests returned 503 in last 20m; affected customers: CIF-42 (low volume test) and some internal e2e runs. no widespread consumer outage yet. filing CEA.

alex chen: post-incident actions: build a composite dashboard (tokens/sec by pool, queue_depth p50/p95/p99, throttle_count, model_fallback_rate, node_mem_pressure). drafting now.

maria rodriguez: also want autoscale to use 95th percentile tokens/sec per-node (not mean) and add hysteresis for short spikes. this should reduce false scale-outs when a single hot shard appears.

sam jasper: agree. require sustained >2m at threshold before scale-out and scale linearly.

leo: will open a PR for alert tuning: change queue_depth alerts to p95 thresholds, add throttle correlation, set FOR 2m, eval_interval=30s. linking PR to infra-alerts epic.

alex chen: if burst override doesn't hold, plan B is cross-region failover to secondary eu region; ops runbook ready.

ops-bot: incident update: posted to #incidents and emailed SRE rotation.

sam jasper: once stable, run a focused chaos experiment to reproduce hot-shard and validate autoscale heuristics.

maria rodriguez: filing ticket INF-8234 "Tune autoscale + composite alerts for hot-path capacity" with tasks: create dashboard, PR alert changes, run chaos, CEA + followups.

leo: assigned myself for PR + dashboard. ETA 48h for PR + grafana panels; will include prom queries and JSON export.

sam jasper: thanks — monitoring closely. will post another update in 10m.
